answer: During load shedding, the generator will start within about 30 seconds to restore power. The AC and lift will still work as they are designed to run during power cuts. Please ensure the AC is set to 24 to 26 °C and keep windows and balcony doors closed. The lift will continue to operate normally. If a lift stops between floors, use the alarm button and contact security.
guest_message: What happens during load shedding? Will the AC and the lift still work?
